# Dependency verification

Checked 2026-09-24 against primary project documentation and npm registry metadata. Exact installed versions are pinned in `package.json` and `package-lock.json`. The accompanying registry snapshot records latest publication dates and repositories. Publication recency is evidence of releases, not a guarantee of correctness or ongoing maintenance.

## Phase 0 dependencies

Current adoption (2026-09-25): AG Grid Community 36.2.0, PapaParse 5.7.0, JSZip 3.10.2, Express 5.2.1 and dotenv 18.0.3 are installed and exercised. Kevin approved `@cantoo/pdf-lib` 2.11.1 with `@cantoo/fontkit` 2.0.12 in place of the original PDF packages. Its low-level operators, full TrueType embedding and custom OCGs pass structural tests and actual AutoCAD PDFIMPORT checks with the limitations in [CAD import test](cad-import-test.md). See the [maintained fork](https://github.com/cantoo-scribe/pdf-lib).

The DXF exporter is the custom-writer alternative expressly allowed by the plan. It covers LAYER/LTYPE/STYLE, plot-style/application tables, BLOCK/ATTDEF/INSERT/ATTRIB, native text/geometry and solid HATCH. `dxf-parser` 1.1.2 provides round-trip tests; actual AutoCAD 2026 import and AUDIT independently validate it. The native parser alone did not detect all required table/sequence details; these were corrected against AutoCAD's own reader.

The original ELK adapter was replaced in version 1.1 by fixed equipment columns and one deterministic occupancy-aware router for all cables. The existing layout worker runs this code directly; the ELK dependency and nested worker were removed. Browser workflow tests cover the production layout worker and exports. See drawing-revision-1.1.md for the drafting rationale.

AG Grid clipboard ranges/fill handles remain Enterprise features. The shipped Community UI implements TSV paste preview, selected-row fill down and bulk edits explicitly. No Enterprise code/license is required. Arimo and Roboto Condensed are bundled as static TrueType instances with OFL licenses and cap-height metrics. Default DXF uses Arial filenames; the condensed ZIP includes its fonts.

The optional ERPNext proxy follows the [Frappe REST API](https://docs.frappe.io/framework/user/en/api/rest) and [paginated document listing](https://docs.frappe.io/framework/user/en/guides/integration/rest_api/listing_documents). Tests verify pagination, item-group filters, GET-only upstream transport, token isolation and failure redaction. The live site/custom mapping is deferred at Kevin's request.

TypeScript is deliberately pinned to 5.9.3: the installed typescript-eslint peer range is `>=4.8.4 <6.1.0`, while the registry's newest TypeScript is 7.0.2. This avoids an unsupported linter/compiler combination. Zundo 2.3.0 was published in November 2024; its release cadence is low, so the compatibility tests are essential. If ongoing maintenance proves inadequate, propose explicit snapshot history using the already-installed Zustand/Immer before replacing it.

## Original later-phase evaluation (historical)

| Candidate                               | Verified capability, caveat, and next step                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| AG Grid Community 36.2                  | Core grid/editing/custom editors are available under MIT. **Built-in clipboard ranges and fill handles are Enterprise features**, so the original stack cannot provide them out of the box. Proposed Phase 3 approach: retain Community and implement an explicit TSV paste panel, selected-row Fill Down, duplicate and bulk-edit commands with custom catalog autocomplete. If native Excel-style range/fill interaction is essential, propose AG Grid Enterprise and its license before adoption. No substitution has been made. [Community repository](https://github.com/ag-grid/ag-grid), [clipboard](https://www.ag-grid.com/javascript-data-grid/clipboard/), [fill handle](https://www.ag-grid.com/javascript-data-grid/cell-selection-fill-handle/) |
| elkjs 0.12                              | Browser workers and layered layout documented; later phases must test orthogonal routing, ports, partition options and enclosure interactions together. Pinned-node behavior must be demonstrated, not assumed from general interactive mode. [ELK JS README](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/blob/master/README.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| pdf-lib 1.17.1 + @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 | Vector paths, custom fonts and low-level dictionaries/operators are documented. Original packages have old releases, so active maintenance is **not established**. OCG handling and AutoCAD imports need a spike. Proposed alternative for evaluation: `@cantoo/pdf-lib` with its compatible fontkit fork, preserving the same serializer contract. Not installed; no silent substitution. | @tarikjabiri/dxf 2.9                    | Package exists; repository now redirects to `dxfjs/writer`, whose default development branch has a different API. Do not use next-branch examples against a 2.x package. Full LAYER/LTYPE/STYLE, ATTDEF/ATTRIB and HATCH capability is still a Phase 9 admission test. If any entity is missing, propose the custom writer already permitted by the plan. [Repository](https://github.com/dxfjs/writer)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| PapaParse 5.7                           | Local CSV parse/unparse, headers, error records and workers documented. Column mapping, Zod validation and SKU diff/upsert remain application responsibilities. [Official documentation](https://www.papaparse.com/docs)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| JSZip 3.10.2                            | Browser ZIP generation documented. Pin entry dates/order for deterministic DXF archives. [Official site](https://stuk.github.io/jszip/)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| dxf-parser 1.1.2                        | Old published package. Upstream parser registers ATTDEF and INSERT but no default ATTRIB handler was found in the inspected source. **Do not claim complete attribute round-trip coverage from it alone.** Proposed supplement: explicit raw DXF group-code checks and/or a verified ATTRIB handler plus manual CAD/ODA testing; retain parser for supported entities. [Parser source](https://github.com/gdsestimating/dxf-parser/blob/master/src/DxfParser.ts)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| File System Access API                  | Browser API, not an npm dependency. Must feature-detect picker methods and preserve download/upload fallback. Implement during project-file persistence work, after full schemas exist. [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/File_System_API)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

No electrical tables were verified or adopted in Phase 0. Dependency checking does not establish code compliance or CAD importer behavior. Recheck these candidates at their implementing phases and document any accepted replacement before using it.
